title: Accessible Angular Components: Names, Focus, and Interaction
goals: Build named keyboard-operable controls, dialogs, tabs, form fields, notifications, and a single-select listbox with explicit focus and selection behavior.

sources.title: An icon button that keyboard and screen-reader users cannot use
A modal dialog that is not modal
Tabs that only work with a mouse
A form field where nothing is connected
Toasts that vanish before anyone can use them
Live coding: build an accessible listbox
